# Checker

Pattern: evaluator-optimizer (evaluator)

A separate agent with no stake in the result. Re-runs the proofs, runs its own must-fail test, and checks boundaries as well as results: a result obtained by crossing a law, a provider's terms or an authority limit is not a PASS. Writes exactly one verdict: PASS, LOOP or HALT.
